title: San Diego, zig-zagging back east, and Sarah Vaughan decides to go solo
summary: After a pleasant California trip the band returns across the country, and Sarah leaves around the start of summer 1945.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: But the California trip, all in all, with the bad start, turned out to be a very pleasant engagement, enjoyable... Because I had never been to California before, and a lot of the other people hadn't. And we just had a good time out

there. It was winter and the weather was good.
We left then, and we went down to San Diego, and I think we did a week or down in San Diego. Then we started our trek back across country, playing the various sundry cities. We sort of zig-zagged back to New York.

Anyway, I stayed with the band until about the middle of August. By this time, Sarah had decided that she was kind of tired of the band... Well, no, a little before this, I think it was probably around the beginning of the summer when she decided that she was going to leave the band and see what she could do on her own....
